usedFor: Detectify holds assets and groups, and Google Drive receives a file through “Copy a File” for each “New Asset”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Asset” in Detectify, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new asset gets a copy of a chosen file, placed in a selected folder.

watchOut: “New Asset” in Detectify is polling, so the copy arrives after a scheduled check.
